subject: general
question: Which of the following vitamins is ABSENT in egg?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Vitamin C__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Vitamin which is Absent in Egg is **Vitamin C**.
 
• Vitamin C **Controls Infections and Healing Wounds**.
 
• Vitamin C is also called as **Ascorbic acid.**
 
• Vitamin C is a water-soluble vitamin that is naturally present in some foods.
 
• Eggs also contain decent amounts of **vitamin D, E, K, B6, calcium, and zinc**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ** Sources of Vitamin C:**

 
 
• **​__**__C__itrus fruit, (like oranges and orange juice).
 
• Peppers.
 
• Strawberries.
 
• Blackcurrants.
 
• Broccoli.
 
• Brussels sprouts.
 
• Potatoes.
